entities.summary: Kazimierz Romaniuk was a Polish Catholic prelate, professor of biblical studies and participant of the Warsaw Uprising. In 2004, Romaniuk became the bishop emeritus of the diocese of Warszawa-Praga. He was previously the rector of the Higher Metropolitan Seminary and the Academic Study of Catholic Theology in Warsaw, the auxiliary bishop of Warsaw, and the diocesan bishop of Warsaw-Praga.
